NUTR 501: Integration of nutritional, biomedical, biochemical, physiological, and hormonal processes involved in carbohydrate, lipid, and protein metabolism.
NUTR 502: Complementary to NUTR 501 with an emphasis on metabolic roles of vitamin and mineral elements.
